review.audio: The complete38-second encoded audio stream decodes without error, and an audition file was output for playback. Cue/master identity and timing, clean authored fades and measured headroom are verified. No subjective listening assessment is claimed because a supported audio-input listening path was unavailable.
review.limitations: Screen recording contains no captured audio. This is an explicit editorial overlay from original masters, synchronized to measured actual control/discovery timestamps. Native screen footage retains its recording compression; 3× enlargement uses nearest-neighbor pixels.
